description: This file defines the ExpenseType entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models an expense type with properties such as id, name, description, associated user, status, and deletion flag, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ExpenseType
classes.description: Represents an expense type entity with properties for id, name, description, user, status, and deletion status, including associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the expense type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the expense type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the expense type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the expense type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the expense type.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the expense type.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with this expense type.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a user with this expense type.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the expense type.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the expense type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the expense type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense type as deleted or not.
